relations: The mirror reflection duplicates the dancer's pose, so any limb shift appears symmetrically in the glass.
Her raised fist lifts higher while the extended arm sweeps forward, rotating her torso toward the mirror.
Both arms converge at the chest with open palms, then fold across each other briefly.
One arm bends across the body as the other rests on the hip, then extends diagonally upward.
caption: The video captures a woman in a black floral dress with red trim and red leg warmers standing center-left in a brightly lit dance studio. A full-height mirror fills the right wall, and track spotlights dot the dark ceiling above a white left wall holding an air-conditioning unit. Her reflection, not a second dancer, mirrors every movement. She holds a pose with one arm bent and raised near her head and the other extended outward to the side. The raised fist lifts higher, then the extended arm sweeps forward and her torso turns slightly toward the glass. The two arms then draw together in front of her chest, palms opening. They fold across one another for a brief interval. Afterward one arm bends across the body while the other hand rests on her hip. That arm extends forward and rises diagonally upward as the hand leaves the hip and moves out to the side into a high open-arm position.
